sources.title: Add MS 46700 — Alice's Adventures Under Ground
sources.claimBound: Binds the autograph manuscript, its relation to the expanded Wonderland story, and the 1865 publication history.

sources.title: Lewis Carroll timeline
sources.claimBound: Binds the 1862 oral-story/manuscript origin, 1865 publication, and 1871 Through the Looking-Glass publication.

sources.title: Furious
sources.claimBound: Alice Black is an FBI agent pursuing a female serial killer; both pursue justice and the line between right and wrong begins to blur.

sources.title: Furious: Hulu's Gripping New Crime Thriller Is Now Streaming
sources.claimBound: Binds Alice Black, Catherine, the July 27, 2026 premiere, eight episodes, and the fictional loose adaptation of Black Widow (1987).

sources.title: Channel Zero: Butcher's Block
sources.claimBound: Binds Alice Woods, Zoe, the Peach family, an offered life without illness, and an unimaginable cost.

sources.title: The Red Door: Season 3, Episode 5
sources.claimBound: Binds the red door, the attempted cure, Alice's changed hunger, the Peach-family coercion, and Zoe's effort to save her.

sources.title: Alice: Madness Returns
sources.claimBound: Binds the horror game, Alice's family loss, institutional history, distorted Wonderland, and her search for the truth.

sources.title: Batwoman Is a Deliciously Twisted Story of Family Betrayal
sources.claimBound: Binds Alice as Beth Kane, her childhood nightmare, family rupture, violent antagonist role, and continuing wish for family connection.

sources.title: Once Upon a Time in Wonderland
sources.claimBound: Binds the series referent; institutional disbelief and proposed memory-erasure treatment remain synopsis-level story claims.

sources.title: The Magicians
sources.claimBound: Binds the series and Alice Quinn referent; episode-specific transformation claims require an episode source.

sources.title: Alice
sources.claimBound: Binds the 2009 miniseries, mirror portal, emotion-harvesting Wonderland, missing father, and hope as a counterforce.

sources.title: Alice in Borderland
sources.claimBound: Binds Arisu and Usagi as distinct characters in a survival-thriller series; Alice is not the name of a female protagonist in this referent.

sources.title: Agatha All Along
sources.claimBound: Binds the series and its cast context; a detailed Alice Wu-Gulliver mechanism requires an episode-level source.

sources.title: Resident Evil: Retribution press release
sources.claimBound: Binds Alice, Umbrella and the film-franchise referent; this is a film line rather than a television series.

sources.title: Dreams of Alice
sources.claimBound: Binds the Russian mystical-series candidate and its teenage Alice referent.

sources.title: Alice, Sweet Alice
sources.claimBound: Binds the 1976 horror-film candidate in which suspicion falls on a young Alice; it is not a series.

sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und Bundesamt für Justiz
sources.title: Zivilprozessordnung — § 138 Erklärungspflicht über Tatsachen; Wahrheitspflicht
sources.claimBound: Binds the civil-procedure duties to explain factual allegations completely and truthfully, respond to opposing allegations, and limit declarations of no knowledge.

sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und Bundesamt für Justiz
sources.title: Zivilprozessordnung — § 142 Anordnung der Urkundenvorlegung
sources.claimBound: Binds the court's power to order production of identified documents or records in a party's or third party's possession within the statutory scope.

sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und Bundesamt für Justiz
sources.title: Zivilprozessordnung — § 286 Freie Beweiswürdigung
sources.claimBound: Binds judicial evaluation of the complete hearing record and any evidence; the audit itself does not perform that judicial function.

sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und Bundesamt für Justiz
sources.title: Allgemeines Gleichbehandlungsgesetz — § 22 Beweislast
sources.claimBound: Binds the statutory burden rule after a party proves indicia supporting a prohibited-discrimination inference; it is not a universal burden shift.

sources.title: Beschluss vom 22. August 2013 — 1 BvR 1067/12
sources.claimBound: Binds fair handling of pleading and proof burdens and rejects requirements whose fulfilment is factually impossible where internal state processes are inaccessible.

sources.title: Urteil vom 14. Juni 2023 — 8 AZR 136/22
sources.claimBound: Binds a narrow AGG and SGB IX case in which an external applicant did not need internal indicia inaccessible to him before the employer had to explain its internal compliance process.

sources.title: Urteil vom 1. Juli 2021 — 8 AZR 297/20
sources.claimBound: Binds secondary substantiation where an external applicant lacked access to an employer's internal dispatch process while the employer could explain it.

sources.title: Urteil vom 16. September 2020 — 10 AZR 56/19
sources.claimBound: Binds the general secondary-substantiation test based on lack of knowledge and investigative access on one side and knowledge plus reasonable explanatory ability on the other.

sources.title: Urteil vom 7. Februar 2024 — 5 AZR 177/23
sources.claimBound: Binds that secondary substantiation does not by itself reverse the burden of proof or require a party to supply every fact needed for the opponent's success.

sources.title: Urteil vom 20. März 2014 — 2 AZR 75/13
sources.claimBound: Binds that alleged evidence frustration does not automatically make the other party's allegations admitted; possible evidentiary consequences require case-specific evaluation.

sources.title: Urteil vom 6. März 2025 — IX ZR 209/23
sources.claimBound: Binds the distinction between secondary substantiation, proof burden and document-production duties under information asymmetry.
